description: the exact record VE-2 populates, one per selected example. Fields that do not apply carry an explicit NOT_APPLICABLE or NOT_AVAILABLE.

fields.name: selection_rank
fields.note: 1-based rank in the deterministic ordering, after any recorded skip

fields.name: selection_rank_key
fields.note: the SHA-256 hex digest that produced the rank, recorded so the ordering can be recomputed

fields.name: skipped_ranks
fields.note: every rank skipped before this one, each with its question_id and its recorded mechanical reason. Empty list if none

fields.name: image_path
fields.note: path under the GQA image directory; the image bytes are not copied into the record

fields.name: image_sha256
fields.note: hash of the image file actually rendered

fields.name: n_program_steps
fields.note: GQA semantic program length; a proxy for reasoning depth, never described as a measured reasoning chain

fields.name: systems
fields.note: one entry per compared system: system_id, arm, scale, seed, condition, predicted_answer or NOT_AVAILABLE, correct, evidence_path, evidence_sha256

fields.name: selection_category_interpretation
fields.note: the interpretation_bound copied verbatim from the category, so a caption cannot drift from it

fields.name: limitation
fields.note: must state that a single example is illustrative and supports no quantitative claim

fields.name: source_hashes
fields.note: sha256 of every artefact read to build this record

fields.name: placement
fields.note: MAIN_TEXT or APPENDIX, inherited from the category

prohibitions: No scene graph, program trace or reasoning chain may be shown that is not present in the canonical evidence. GQA program length is a count, not a chain, and must not be rendered as one.
No attention map may be presented as a causal explanation of a prediction. The v3_02a attention diagnostics are diagnostics.
No predicted answer may be invented, paraphrased or normalised beyond the scorer's own normalisation, and where no prediction string is stored the field reads NOT_AVAILABLE.
No example may come from the clean test.
No example may be replaced because a different one reads better.
title: qualitative record schema
